claims.statement: Tom Allen arrived in Chicago from St. Louis on November 17, 1875.
claims.excerpt:
On yesterday, Allen arrived in this
city from St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen planned to stay in Chicago for a couple of days after the match was made.
claims.excerpt:
Allen will remain in the city for a couple
of days

claims.statement: In Chicago, Barney Aaron for Allen and Harry Hill for Mace put a deposit with Mike McDonald and drew up articles for a $5,000-a-side fight on May 20, 1876.

fights.notes: Planned bout; not yet fought. The deposit amount is garbled in the OCR ('a8 side') and is left out. The Republic report (527) gives $5,000.

notes: Reprinted from the Chicago Times of Nov. 18. The Republic dateline (527) gives Nov. 15 for the match; this account says Nov. 17.
